description: An EOB from a fictional self-funded employer plan for three in-network visits, one claim per billing provider: urgent care, an X-ray at a hospital outpatient department (hospital charge and radiologist's reading) and in-network lab work. The seed sets plan option (PPO or HSA-qualified), coverage tier and insurer. Nothing is wrong, so a review should find it correct: a clean control for statements from an urgent care center, hospital, lab and clinician's practice.

sources.what: Content of a notice of adverse benefit determination (every EOB that pays less than billed)
sources.source: 29 CFR 2560.503-1(g); 29 CFR 2590.715-2719(b)(2)(ii)(E); DOL claims procedure FAQ C-12, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-29/subtitle-B/chapter-XXV/subchapter-G/part-2560/section-2560.503-1

sources.what: Cost sharing on the allowed amount; no balance billing in network
